`interface ITextEffect`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.effect` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ITextEffect.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/effect/ITextEffect.java)

An effect on the glyphs of a text, which can move, recolor or replace each glyph and draw behind or over it.

## Description

Give effects to a [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/) with `effects(...)`, or add them from a markup tag with [`TextStyle.effect`](/reference/text/textstyle/#TextStyle-method-effect).
JOID calls the three hooks for every glyph, on the render thread, in this order: `apply` for each glyph, then `background`, then the glyphs are drawn, then `decorate`.
A shadow glyph goes through the same hooks: test [`ITextGlyph.isShadow`](/reference/text/itextglyph/#ITextGlyph-method-isShadow) to skip it.

## Method details

<a id="ITextEffect-method-apply"></a>

### apply

`void apply(ITextGlyph glyph)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

JOID calls it once per glyph before anything is drawn.
Change the glyph there: its offset, its color or its codepoint; reading [`ITextGlyph.getIndex`](/reference/text/itextglyph/#ITextGlyph-method-getIndex) and the clock gives per-character animations such as a wave.

<a id="ITextEffect-method-background"></a>

### background

`void background(ITextGlyph glyph)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

JOID calls it once per glyph after `apply`, before the glyphs are drawn: draw a highlight or a box behind the glyph, in design pixels, with [`DrawUtils`](/reference/drawing/drawutils/).

<a id="ITextEffect-method-decorate"></a>

### decorate

`void decorate(ITextGlyph glyph)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

JOID calls it once per glyph after the glyphs are drawn: draw an underline, a strike-through or a cursor over the glyph.
